transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I’m the one not making sense, but I know what’s been going on. They’ve been watching what I do, watching my moves, and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot. I’m tired of everyone acting like I’m crazy when I can see it happening.
Can you tell me more about how you know people are watching you and changing things at work? Have you noticed any specific signs or behaviors that make you feel this way?

It’s just… at work I can tell when they’re keeping tabs on me. People will stop talking when I come near, or they’ll be looking over like they’re checking what I’m doing. And then the pallet counts don’t match what I know I did. It keeps happening right when I’m trying to prove I can handle that supervisor position.

My husband says I’m reading into it, and people at the warehouse act like I’m making it up, but I’m not. I know they’re watching my moves and messing with the counts so I don’t get promoted.
Have you ever felt that people are watching or following you outside of work, or that things in your personal life are being controlled or changed by others without your knowledge?

Mostly it’s at work. That’s where I see it happening — people watching what I’m doing, keeping track of my moves, and then the pallet counts getting changed. At home, my husband just keeps acting like I’m crazy for saying it, like I’m making it up. But I know what I’ve seen. They’re doing it so I don’t get that supervisor spot.
Have you ever had thoughts that were not related to work, that others might have thought were strange or unusual, that you believed strongly but others did not?

Not really outside of that. I mean, people say it sounds strange when I say it, but it’s about what’s happening at the warehouse. My husband and the people there act like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching my moves and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot.
Have you ever had any beliefs or thoughts that others might not understand or think are unusual that weren’t related to what’s happening at work?

No, not really. It’s mainly this thing at work. That’s why I came in—because my husband and the warehouse people keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot.
Have you ever had any thoughts or beliefs that others might find strange or hard to understand that weren’t related to what’s happening at work?

Like I said, no, not really outside of work. It’s this thing at the warehouse. I came in because my husband and the people there keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do and changing the pallet counts to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.

Have you ever had any experiences or beliefs that others might not understand, even outside of what’s happening at work, like feeling that someone is trying to harm you, send you messages, or control your thoughts?

No, not like messages or controlling my thoughts. It’s really about work. I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep saying I’m acting crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get the supervisor position.

Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions about things that others might not understand, even when you weren’t at work—like thinking someone was trying to harm you, send you secret messages, or that something strange was happening around you?

Not secret messages or anything like that. I just know what’s been going on at the warehouse. My husband and people there keep acting like I’m making it up, but they’ve been watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor spot.
Have you ever had any suspicions or beliefs that someone was trying to harm you or that something strange was happening around you in situations that weren't related to work?

No, I mean… not really outside of work. The only thing is what I’ve been saying—my husband and the people at the warehouse act like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do and messing with the pallet counts so I don’t get that supervisor job.
Outside of your concerns about work, have there ever been times when you believed something strongly that others found difficult to understand or didn’t agree with?

Not really outside of that. I know I keep coming back to the warehouse, but that’s the thing that’s actually happening. My husband and the people there keep acting like I’m crazy, but I know they’ve been watching what I do and changing the pallet counts so I don’t get the supervisor spot.
